markets.rules_secondary:
Player Participation & Settlement Criteria
If Yandy Díaz is scratched or not included in the starting lineup, the market will resolve to the fair market price.
If Yandy Díaz starts the game but does not record a plate appearance, the market will resolve to the fair market price.
If Yandy Díaz is not in the starting lineup but later enters the game, the market will resolve to the fair market price, pinch hit at bats will not count towards the market.
If Yandy Díaz is in the starting lineup and records at least one plate appearance the market will settle based on stolen bases recorded.
